# Preamble

```{r, echo = FALSE}
options(digits = 4)
```

This mini book exercises every rewriting rule of
[BiocBook](https://github.com/js2264/BiocBook). It is used to test
`from_bookdown()`.

```{r logo, fig.margin=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="A logo."}
knitr::include_graphics("./img/logo.png")
```

```{r env_0, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("tools"))
library(utils)
```

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
BiocManager::install("someone/somepkg")
library(neverloaded)
```

```{r bib, include=FALSE}
knitr::write_bib(c('base', 'knitr'), file = 'skeleton.bib')
```

The introduction is in chapter \@ref(intro), the annex in \@ref(sec-annex).
